properties.text:
Anti-genocide protesters gathered outside Manhattan’s 92NY to picket against a talk by Zionist NYT columnist and genocide denier Bret Stephens, a longtime staunch supporter of Israel, a genocidal, ethno-supremacist apartheid state built on the theft and destruction of Palestinian life.
The NYT is a Zionist newspaper. For decades, in both its opinion and news reporting sections, it has been manufacturing consent for Israel’s crimes against Palestinians, including apartheid, property theft, abductions, ethnic cleansing, genocide, and obstruction of the Palestinians’ right of return to their stolen homes and lands in what is now Israel, from Gaza, the West Bank, and areas outside historic Palestine. It’s a right enshrined in international law in addition to being a matter of basic decency.
#nyt #epsteinfiles #palestinianrightofreturn
